properties.name: inertia.favicon
properties.description: The URL of the favicon of the page. A root-relative URL is resolved against the context path. No favicon is linked when not set.

properties.name: inertia.title
properties.description: The title of the page until a page component sets its own. Defaults to the application name (`info.app.name`).

properties.name: inertia.manifest.location
properties.description: The location of the Vite manifest, used outside the development environment to resolve the built JavaScript and CSS files.

properties.name: inertia.vite.devServer.enabled
properties.description: Whether the page loads the JavaScript from the Vite dev server instead of the built assets. Defaults to true in the development environment and false in all other environments.

properties.name: inertia.vite.devServer.url
properties.description: The URL of the Vite dev server.

properties.name: inertia.vite.entry
properties.description: The entry point of the JavaScript application, as passed to Vite. Used to load it from the dev server and to look it up in the Vite manifest.

properties.name: inertia.ssr.url
properties.description: The URL of the server-side rendering service.

properties.name: inertia.ssr.bundle
properties.description: The path to the server-side rendering bundle file.

properties.name: inertia.ssr.connect-timeout
properties.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to establish a connection to the server-side rendering service.

properties.name: inertia.ssr.read-timeout
properties.description: Maximum time in milliseconds to read a response from the server-side rendering service.
